name: efficiency-playbook
description: Installs, upgrades or rolls back an evidence-based, token-efficient Codex setup on Windows by running Part 1 of the bundled Codex playbook, asking before each change.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based, token-efficient Codex setup for Windows
interface.longDescription: Runs Part 1 of the bundled Codex playbook: short global working rules, a command map in the project's AGENTS.md, two explicit-only skills, and four opt-in config questions (Fast mode, auto-review, secrets in commands, Context7). It asks before each change, backs up every file it edits, and records a manifest for rollback.
